verse.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful grapevine, flourishing within your home. Your children will be like vigorous young olive trees as they sit around your table. That is the Lord's blessing for those who fear him.

video.title: How to Lead Your Family Well | Psalm 128:1–4 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: A godly home doesn't happen by accident — it grows the same way a vine or an olive tree does, through steady, patient care over years. Fearing the Lord isn't about perfection; it's about showing up daily, leading with humility, and letting your reverence for God set the tone your wife and kids can see and follow. That quiet consistency is the blessing this verse promises — not a perfect family, but a flourishing one.
